items.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
items.summary: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the prime minister was "unpicking" the deal the UK signed with the EU.

items.title: Man fatally attacked by tiger at UK wildlife park was visiting alone, police say
items.summary: The victim of the tiger attack at Yorkshire Wildlife Park was visiting alone, police have said.

items.title: Government expands police support to political figures who are not MPs
items.summary: Shabana Mahmood says there is "insufficient protection" for those who play a role in public life.

items.title: French supermarket fridges heated to 50C in cyber attack - causing fires and food losses
items.summary: Hackers carried out a cyber attack on hundreds of French supermarkets overnight - pushing temperatures in fridges up to 50C and sparking fires.

items.title: Britain won't tolerate threats on our soil, Miliband says as he summons Iran ambassador
items.summary: The prime minister says Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard "almost certainly" directed the RAF Fairford incident.

items.title: Congresswoman insists she will not be 'silenced' after federal agents raid her home
items.summary: Congresswoman Ilhan Omar said she will "not be silenced" after her home was raided by federal agents, calling it the "latest escalation" in President Donald Trump's "intimidation" campaign.
